name: After § 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text: 5b. Stresses that after more than four years of war, which has imposed reconstruction costs of over EUR 588 billion on Ukraine, killed hundreds of thousands of Ukrainians and led to the migration of millions more, no end to the conflict is currently in sight;
